title: Kakeya in three and four dimensions

result.label: Kakeya in three and four dimensions
result.statement: Resolves the Kakeya maximal conjecture in three dimensions and the Hausdorff-dimension conjecture in four. In three dimensions, the radius- δ tube maximal operator maps L^3( R^3) to L^3(S^2) with norm O ( ^ - ) for every ε > 0. In four dimensions, every set containing a unit segment in every direction has Hausdorff dimension four.
